question: Which lords rule which ranges of the path according to the Mrikshottara?
premises: The Mrikshottara teaches the lords of the path.
Vishnu rules from Ananta up to Pradhana.
The next range extends from Purusha up to Kala.
inference: The scripture assigns specific cosmic ranges to specific lords of the path.
uncertainties: The verse breaks mid-list; the lord of the Purusha-to-Kala range is completed in the next verse.
plain_english: In the revered Mrikshottara, the teacher declared these lords of the path: Vishnu rules from Ananta up to Pradhana, and the next range runs from Purusha up to Kala.
